Name: Simple obelisks
Author: olioleander
Description:
I always struggle to find a good spot for the obelisks because of how big they are, but I couldn't find an existing mod that I felt stuck with the vanilla feel & my aesthetic. These are very simple, using sprites that already existed. They are somewhat inspired by the Overgrown Fairy Buildings Additions' obelisks. At the moment this is a content patcher mod, at some point I might make an Alternative Textures version as well. I also haven't made a texture for the farm obelisk on the island farm since I don't personally have an issue with that one being different and I primarily made this mod for my own satisfaction; if there's enough interest I will make this an option :)

To install, just unzip the file into your mods folder.

Downloads.Description: Fixed the sprites so they no longer have a double shadow
